facts.value: Both Shadow Exchange and Spiritual Body Manifestation are re-attached on login through the runestone marker system for Shadow Monarch vessels

sections.heading: How they slot into the kit
sections.body: The vessel skill code checks two things before giving you these abilities: that you are the Shadow Monarch vessel, and that the runestone marker for the skill exists on your player data. That means the stones gate real kit extensions rather than standalone tricks. Shadow Exchange in particular is the manhwa's signature repositioning tool: park a shadow somewhere safe, and trade places with it later.

sections.heading: The armor connection
sections.body: Spiritual Body Manifestation is how you get the Shadow Monarch's Armor without an item drop: activate the skill with at least 500 MP and the four-piece set materializes over your current armor, which is saved and restored when the manifestation ends. See the Armor Sets page for the full numbers.

nodes.title: Retired Runestones
nodes.tagline: Kept so old saves do not break; they do nothing
nodes.summary: Seven runestones whose display names begin with "Retired" are dead items. Their unbound Mage spells were removed, and the items remain registered only so existing inventories do not turn into missing-item errors.

facts.label: The seven
facts.value: Retired Curse Chains, Retired Curse Sphere, Retired Curse Smoke, Retired Water Slash, Retired Lightball, Retired Light Golem, Retired Magic Missiles Runestone

facts.label: What they do
facts.value: Nothing. The item class has no use action at all

facts.label: Tooltip
facts.value: "This item no longer grants or casts a skill" plus a note that the spell was not tied to a Mage specialization

facts.label: Why they exist
facts.value: Code comment: keeping the registry entries prevents existing inventory stacks from becoming missing mappings

sections.heading: If you have one
sections.body: It is a shelf trophy. Right-clicking does nothing and the stone is never consumed. The spells they used to grant (free-floating Mage skills like Magic Missiles and Water Slash) were retired when Mage magic was reorganized into the five specializations; every current Mage spell lives in one of those schools and has a working runestone listed on the Mage Runestones page.

nodes.title: Ranked Weapons
nodes.tagline: The E-to-S shop ladder: swords, daggers, katanas
nodes.summary: Three parallel weapon ladders run from E rank to S rank: straight swords, daggers, and katanas. They are plain stat sticks sold for gold in the weapon shop. Higher rank means more damage; durability and speed vary by family.

facts.label: Swords (E-S)
facts.value: Tier damage bonus 3/4/5/6/7/9, all 80 durability, all -2.4 attack speed. Shop: 200/250/300/400/600/800 gold

facts.label: S Rank Katana
facts.value: Bonus 9, 440 durability, -2.5 speed

facts.label: Damage math
facts.value: Shown attack = 1 (base) + 3 (weapon) + tier bonus. Example: S Rank Sword shows 13 attack damage

facts.label: Repair
facts.value: None of the ranked weapons has a repair ingredient

sections.heading: Which family to buy
sections.body: Swords are the budget line: cheapest at every rank, identical 80 durability everywhere, so treat them as disposable. Daggers swing much faster (up to 2.4 attacks per second on the S Rank Dagger) and have the most durability per coin in the mid ranks. Katanas hit as hard as swords with better durability but the slowest swing (about 1.2-1.5 attacks per second).

sections.heading: Durability warning
sections.body: Ranked swords break after 80 hits on enemies - each hit on an entity costs one durability, and there is no repair ingredient. The daggers and katanas last several times longer. If you are heading into a long dungeon on a sword budget, buy two.

sections.heading: Where the ladder ends
sections.body: Above the shop ladder sit the named weapons: Knight Killer and Gravity Dagger around 3,000 gold, the Moonlight Refractor and Mythic Dagger near 3,500, and boss-locked gear like Kamish's Wrath and the Demon King's arsenal that gold cannot buy. See Unique Weapons.

sections.heading: Naming trap
sections.body: The item internally called dagger_heat_a displays as "S Rank Dagger" and the internal sword_curved_d displays as "E Rank Katana" - the internal ids do not always match the shown rank. This wiki always uses the shown rank.

nodes.title: Unique Weapons
nodes.tagline: Named gear with actual mechanics attached
nodes.summary: Everything above the shop ladder: boss weapons, set weapons, and oddities. Most named melee weapons share one mechanic - a weapon-empower keybind that arms their special effect for the next hit or attack.

facts.label: Weapon empower
facts.value: A keybind applies a Sword Enhance state while holding a supported named weapon; effects like Kasaka's paralysis, the Gravity Dagger's levitation, and the Demon King Long Sword's lightning only trigger while it is active

facts.label: Supported weapons (verified)
facts.value: Kamish's Wrath, Demon King's Long Sword, dual Demon King's Daggers, Knight Killer, Mythic Dagger, Baruka's Dagger, Frost Blade, both Kasaka fangs

facts.label: National Rank tier
facts.value: Dragon Shortsword: 21 attack, 2.1 speed, 2,800 durability, enchant value 20 - the strongest stat stick in the mod

facts.label: Shop-purchasable uniques
facts.value: Katana of the Dwarf King 2,000g, Heavy Titan's Resonance and War Axe 2,140g each, Gravity Dagger 2,840g, Knight Killer 3,000g, Moonlight Refractor 3,400g, Mythic Dagger 3,675g

facts.label: Unbreakable club
facts.value: Demon King's weapons, Baruka's Dagger, Awakened Venom Fang, Mythic, Gravity, Moonlight Refractor, Frost Blade, Demonic Sai never lose durability

sections.heading: The headliners
sections.body: Four weapon lines get their own pages: Kamish's Wrath (the craftable twin dragon fangs), the Demon King's arsenal (dagger pair and long sword from the Demon King's Castle), Kasaka's Venom Fangs (paralysis daggers), and Baruka's Dagger. The Spirit Bow covers ranged.

sections.heading: Shop uniques worth knowing
sections.body: Knight Killer (10 attack, only 100 durability) deals +25% against armored enemies per its tooltip. Mythic Dagger: hold right-click to counter - if you are hit, the damage is nullified and you teleport behind the attacker. Gravity Dagger: empowered hits levitate the target for 3 seconds. Moonlight Refractor is a straight 12-attack unbreakable dagger. Katana of the Dwarf King (14 attack, 1,600 durability) inflicts Bleed and has a right-click ability; it is also a 1-in-130 roll from the System's Random Item reward.

sections.heading: Utility and caster gear
sections.body: Frost Blade slows every target it hits (Slowness II, 2s). Demonic Sai teleports you to the enemy after a throw with a second of invincibility. Ice Spear is a heavy 18-attack spear with 100 durability. Storm Griamore is a held tome whose Tempest Authority passive adds Intelligence (+10 plus 10% of your base INT) while held. Orb of Avarice doubles magic damage while held but raises mana costs by 50%, and adds the same style of INT bonus; it drops from the Demon King's Castle floor 10 boss. Mana Gun is Ranger-only: each shot costs 100 + your effective Intelligence in MP and fires a piercing mana bullet (3 + INT/50 base damage, 1s cooldown).

sections.heading: Heavy Titan pair
sections.body: Heavy Titan's Resonance (hammer) and Heavy Titan's War Axe are 13-attack, very slow (-3.2 speed) giant weapons with no durability loss, sold for 2,140 gold. The hammer also appears in the Random Item reward pool.

nodes.title: Kamish's Wrath
nodes.tagline: Craft a dragon's fang into the strongest dagger pair
nodes.summary: Kamish's Wrath and its twin, Kamish's Wrath - Twin Fang, are craftable epic daggers made from Kamish Tooth. Each fang you hold converts your permanent Strength and Intelligence into bonus Strength, and both fangs stack.

facts.label: Attack
facts.value: 12 attack damage modifier (13 shown), -2.4 attack speed, no durability loss, Epic

facts.label: Crafting (Special Crafting GUI)
facts.value: Stick + Kamish Tooth + Mana Crystal S = Kamish's Wrath; Blaze Rod + Kamish Tooth + Mana Crystal S = Twin Fang

facts.label: Passive: Mana Sensitivity
facts.value: Per held fang: Strength +(10 + 10% permanent STR) + (10 + 10% permanent INT), percentages floored; main hand and offhand both count

facts.label: Other sources
facts.value: Random Special Box: 20% chance for both fangs; Selection Special Box: option 1 grants both

facts.label: Twin Fang extra
facts.value: While weapon-empowered and fully charged (charge 60), swinging releases a wide 180-degree arc attack

sections.heading: Why dual-wield it
sections.body: Mana Sensitivity is computed per fang and multiplied by the number of fangs you hold. With 100 permanent Strength and 100 permanent Intelligence, one fang gives +40 Strength and the pair gives +80. The bonus reads your permanent stats only - temporary buffs never feed back into it - so it scales exactly with your long-term build.

sections.heading: Getting the ingredients
sections.body: Kamish Tooth is an ingredient item (stacks to 4) dropped in Kamish content; the tooltip calls it a fang ripped from the great dragon. Mana Crystal S is the top crystal grade - the Random Special Box pays out 1-4 of them on its most common roll. The Special Crafting GUI is opened from the System panel.

sections.heading: The charged arc
sections.body: The Twin Fang variant watches your charge meter. Activate weapon empower, build the charge to its cap of 60, then swing: the dagger releases a 4-block-radius, 180-degree particle arc attack in front of you. The base Wrath does not have the swing release, so the pair is main-hand Twin Fang, offhand Wrath for most players.

nodes.title: Demon King's Arsenal
nodes.tagline: Baran's dagger pair and long sword
nodes.summary: The Demon King's Dagger and Demon King's Long Sword come from floor 20 of the Demon King's Castle. The daggers have a two-piece set effect; the sword calls lightning storms and boosts Intelligence while held.

facts.label: Demon King's Dagger
facts.value: 12 shown attack, -2.1 speed, unbreakable, S class per tooltip

facts.label: Set effect: Two as One
facts.value: Both hands holding a Demon King's Dagger: Strength +(20 + 20% of base Strength)

facts.label: Demon King's Long Sword
facts.value: 14 shown attack, -2.8 speed, unbreakable, fire resistant

facts.label: Sword passive: Demonic Attunement
facts.value: Intelligence +(10 + 10% of base INT) while held

facts.label: Sword active: Storm of the Flames
facts.value: While empowered, a hit strikes up to 4 nearby enemies (7 for the White Flame Monarch vessel) with lightning dealing 5 + INT/15 each; 3s cooldown; 15-block area

facts.label: Sources
facts.value: DKC floor 20 rewards include the dagger and long sword; beating Baran legitimately adds a one-time second dagger plus the Shadow Exchange Stone; Random Special Box rolls 20% for two daggers or 20% for the sword; Selection Special Box offers either as a pick

sections.heading: Completing the dagger pair
sections.body: Floor 20 hands you one dagger. The second comes from Baran's one-time victory reward (which also carries the Shadow Exchange Stone), from the Random Special Box's dagger roll (which gives two at once), or from the Selection Special Box. Two as One only checks that both hands hold the dagger - it reads your base Strength and adds a flat 20 plus 20%, floored.

sections.heading: Playing the long sword
sections.body: The sword is a caster-fighter hybrid. Held in either hand it adds Intelligence, which in turn feeds its own lightning damage (5 + INT/15 per bolt). Activate weapon empower, hit something, and every valid enemy within 15 blocks gets struck, respecting your team and your tamed pets. The proc then goes on a 3-second cooldown.

sections.heading: The castle route
sections.body: The Demon King's Castle is opened with the bound Demon King's Castle Key (see Keys and Boxes). Floor 1 (Cerberus) pays an Entry Permit, World Trees Fragment, and a full recovery; floor 10 (Vulcan) pays another permit, Spring Water of the Echoing Forest, a full recovery, and the Orb of Avarice; floor 20 pays Purified Blood of the Demon King plus both Demon King weapons.

nodes.title: Kasaka's Venom Fangs
nodes.tagline: Paralyze first, then take them apart
nodes.summary: Two daggers carved from Kasaka's fang. Both paralyze on an empowered hit; the base fang works on C-rank targets and below, the Awakened version on B-rank and below.

facts.label: Kasaka's Venom Fang (base)
facts.value: 9 shown attack, -2.1 speed, 6,000 durability, C class per tooltip

facts.label: Kasaka's Awakened Venom Fang
facts.value: 13 shown attack, -1.8 speed, unbreakable, S class per tooltip

facts.label: Paralysis (both)
facts.value: Empowered hit applies Darkness, Slowness, Weakness, and Glowing (amplifier 10) for 4 seconds; consumes the empowerment; 10s cooldown

facts.label: Rank ceiling
facts.value: Base fang: targets at combat rank C or below. Awakened: rank B or below (rank scale E=1 to S=6)

facts.label: Source (base)
facts.value: First-kill System reward for the Fanged Kasaka boss

sections.heading: How the paralysis actually works
sections.body: Activate the weapon-empower keybind while holding a fang, then land one hit. If the target's resolved combat rank is at or under the fang's ceiling, it is blinded, slowed, weakened, and outlined for 4 seconds - amplifier 10 slow and weakness effectively shuts it down. The empowerment is consumed by the hit, hit or miss on the rank check, and the paralyze cooldown is 10 seconds. Rank is resolved from the mob's dungeon, biome, dimension, or level, so end-game bosses simply shrug it off.

sections.heading: Base versus Awakened
sections.body: The base fang is a mid-game workhorse with a big durability pool. The Awakened fang is the true assassin weapon: unbreakable, the fastest heavy dagger in the mod at -1.8 speed, four more attack, and a rank ceiling one step higher. Neither can be enchanted (enchantment value 0).

nodes.title: Baruka's Dagger
nodes.tagline: The ice elf warlord's featherweight blade
nodes.summary: An unbreakable A-class dagger taken from the warlord Baruka. Solid stats, weapon-empower support, and a first-kill boss reward - a natural mid-to-late Assassin upgrade.

facts.label: Attack
facts.value: 11 shown attack, -2.0 speed, unbreakable

facts.label: Tooltip claims
facts.value: "ATTACK: +110, AGILITY: +10" and weight-reducing magic - lore text; no separate agility stat hook exists in code

facts.label: Source
facts.value: First-kill System reward for defeating Baruka (also pays skill points)

facts.label: Empower
facts.value: Supports the weapon-empower keybind

sections.heading: Where it fits
sections.body: Baruka's Dagger sits between the shop's A-rank dagger and the boss-tier fangs: better than anything gold buys at its speed, free with the boss kill, and it never breaks. If you have not yet built toward Kasaka's Awakened fang or the Kamish pair, this is the dagger you keep on your hotbar.

sections.heading: About the agility line
sections.body: The tooltip advertises +10 Agility from weight-reducing magic. In the current code the dagger registers no stat bonus provider - the verified in-game benefits are its attack stat, unbreakability, and empower support. Treat the agility line as flavor until the stat hook ships.

nodes.title: Spirit Bow
nodes.tagline: An elven bow built for mana arrows
nodes.summary: The Ranger's signature bow. It draws and fires like a vanilla bow but plugs into the Mana Quiver system, letting you replace physical ammunition with staged mana arrows.

facts.label: Type
facts.value: Real BowItem - normal draw, release, and arrow physics

facts.label: Rarity
facts.value: Rare

facts.label: Mana synergy
facts.value: Tooltip: "Mana Quiver can replace ammunition with staged mana arrows"; interception is handled by the Ranger combat manager

facts.label: Source
facts.value: Ranger starter pack: 50% chance (the other half of the coin flip is the Mana Gun)

sections.heading: With and without Mana Quiver
sections.body: Without the Mana Quiver skill this is a sturdy bow with four times vanilla durability. With it, you can toggle mana ammunition and charge beyond full draw into Linear and Seeking arrow stages - the bow itself follows the standard draw path, so every Ranger skill that keys off bow shots (Hyper Focus, High Value Target, Sharpshooter, Rapid Fire) works with it.

sections.heading: Lore
sections.body: The tooltip calls it an elven bow believed to have been forged in another realm.

nodes.title: Armor Sets
nodes.tagline: Manifested battle armor and cosmetic drip
nodes.summary: The two real armor sets - Shadow Monarch's Armor and Goliath Armor - are not loot. They are manifested by abilities, drain your MP every moment they are worn, and vanish back into your old armor when your mana runs dry. Everything else is cosmetic.

facts.label: Shadow Monarch's Armor
facts.value: Defense 6/16/12/2 (helm/chest/legs/boots), toughness 4 per piece, 10% knockback resistance; durabilities 770/1120/1050/910

facts.label: Goliath Armor
facts.value: Defense 7/18/14/3, toughness 5 per piece, 100% knockback resistance per piece; durabilities 880/1280/1200/1040

facts.label: Activation
facts.value: Both require at least 500 MP to manifest; your worn armor is saved and auto-restored when MP drops below 20

facts.label: Upkeep
facts.value: MP drains continuously while manifested (Goliath: 3 MP per tick; Shadow: 3 MP per piece per tick)

facts.label: While worn
facts.value: Constant Regeneration III; pieces self-enchant with Blast Protection II, Curse of Binding, and Curse of Vanishing

facts.label: Cosmetic pieces
facts.value: Choi Jong-In Cloak (10 armor chest, 1,600 durability), Jinwoo Normal and Cold sets (chest 7 / legs 6), Kang Hair helmet (2 armor)

sections.heading: Shadow Monarch's Armor
sections.body: Manifested through the Spiritual Body Manifestation skill (taught by its runestone) as the Shadow Monarch. Press the ability with 500+ MP: your current armor is stored and the four black pieces appear with squid-ink and purple mana particles rolling off you. The Curse of Binding is intentional - you cannot take the pieces off by hand; the manifestation ends itself when your MP is spent.

sections.heading: Goliath Armor
sections.body: Thomas Andre's manifestation, available to his vessel. Same contract: 500 MP to enter, saved armor restored under 20 MP, but with higher defense, toughness 5, and full knockback immunity. Pressing the ability again while wearing the full set ends it early and restores your gear. The MP drain is a flat 3 per tick regardless of how many pieces are on.

sections.heading: Reading the numbers
sections.body: Both sets outclass netherite while active - Goliath totals 42 defense points - but they are timers, not equipment. Your effective wear time is your MP pool divided by the drain, minus whatever you want left over for skills. Mana Potions and the Mana Font blessing extend the window.

sections.heading: The cosmetics
sections.body: Choi Jong-In's Cloak is a legitimate light chestplate. The Jinwoo Normal and Cold outfits (chestplate and leggings each) and Kang Hair are outfit pieces with token armor values and enchant value 9. None of them has a set bonus.

nodes.title: Potions and Elixirs
nodes.tagline: Health, mana, fatigue - and one bottle that resets everything
nodes.summary: Three potion families in three sizes each, plus the Holy Water of Life, a craftable full reset. All are drunk instantly on use and stack to 4 (Holy Water stacks to 6).

facts.label: Health Potions
facts.value: Small +5 HP (2.5 hearts), Medium +20 HP, Large +50 HP

facts.label: Mana Potions
facts.value: Small +1,000 MP, Medium +5,000 MP, Large +10,000 MP

facts.label: Fatigue Potions
facts.value: Small -100, Medium -500, Large -1,000 Fatigue

facts.label: Holy Water of Life
facts.value: Sets HP to max, MP to max, and Fatigue to 0 in one drink

facts.label: Holy Water recipe
facts.value: Special Crafting GUI: Purified Blood of the Demon King + World Trees Fragment + Spring Water of the Echoing Forest = 6 bottles

facts.label: Stack sizes
facts.value: Potions 4; Holy Water 6

sections.heading: Which size to carry
sections.body: Health potions are rated by dungeon difficulty on their tooltips: D, C, and A respectively. The Large Health Potion's 25 hearts overheals most builds to full from near-death. Mana potions are the fuel for manifested armor and high-rank skills - a Large restores 10,000 MP, which is multiple activations of anything in the game. Fatigue potions clear the fatigue stat that builds from exertion; keep Smalls around and save Larges for after boss marathons.

sections.heading: Holy Water of Life
sections.body: An S-class consumable whose tooltip warns the effect only lands when the whole bottle is drunk. In code it is the only true full reset: health to maximum, MP to your full mana stat, fatigue to zero. The three ingredients are all Demon King's Castle rewards - World Trees Fragment from floor 1, Spring Water of the Echoing Forest from floor 10, Purified Blood of the Demon King from floor 20 - so one full castle clear converts into six bottles.

nodes.title: Keys and Boxes
nodes.tagline: What opens what, and what the boxes pay out
nodes.summary: Keys gate dungeons and doors; special boxes gamble gold into end-game weapons. Most keys are consumed on use, and the best key in the game is bound to whoever earned it.

facts.label: Instant Dungeon Key
facts.value: One-time key that teleports you into the instance dungeon via the subway entrance; granted once through the Getting Stronger quest line

facts.label: Job Change Quest Key
facts.value: Right-click to teleport to the Job Change dungeon

facts.label: Demon King's Castle Key (red)
facts.value: Bound to its owner by name, rejects anyone else, consumed on opening the castle; earned from the secret daily quest

facts.label: Blue / Yellow Keys
facts.value: Consumed on matching deepslate keyblocks inside dungeons to break open sealed passages; both appear in the Random Item loot pool

facts.label: Random Special Box
facts.value: 10,000 gold in the Misc shop. Rolls: 20% both Kamish's Wrath fangs, 20% two Demon King's Daggers, 20% Demon King's Long Sword, 40% 1-4 Mana Crystal S

facts.label: Selection Special Box
facts.value: 20,000 gold, once per player ever. Pick one: both Kamish fangs, the Demon King's Long Sword, or two Demon King's Daggers

facts.label: Entry Permit
facts.value: Demon King's Castle re-entry item, paid by floors 1 and 10

sections.heading: The dungeon keys
sections.body: The Instant Dungeon Key is story-locked: the System grants it once during the Getting Stronger quest, entry is tracked on your player data, and the dungeon can only be completed once. The Job Change Quest Key teleports you straight to the Job Change dungeon. The red Demon King's Castle Key is the prize of the secret daily quest; it writes your name into its NBT, shows "Bound to:" on the tooltip, refuses other players with "The key rejects your hand," and is consumed by the castle door. After that first opening you return through the System's DKC path instead.

sections.heading: Dungeon door keys
sections.body: Blue and Yellow Keys are single-use dungeon tools. Right-click the matching colored deepslate keyblock and the key is consumed, the keyblock breaks, and the surrounding unbreakable deepslate shell is cleared away, opening the sealed room. Both drop from the Random Item reward pool.

sections.heading: The gamble math
sections.body: Both boxes are bought from the Misc Items page of the System shop. The Random Special Box is 10,000 gold with a 60% chance of an end-game weapon payout and a 40% consolation of S-grade crystals (worth 640 gold each, 1-4 of them - a bad roll returns at most a quarter of your stake). The Selection Special Box costs twice as much, can only ever be bought once per player, but removes the gamble entirely: open its GUI and take exactly the weapon set you want.

nodes.title: Mastery Items
nodes.tagline: One free skill from your class kit, no runestone needed
nodes.summary: Each class has an epic Mastery item that grants a missing skill from that class's roster when used. Unlike runestones, most of them check your class first.

facts.label: The six
facts.value: Assassin, Mage, Fighter, Tanker, Healer, and Ranger Mastery items; all Epic, stack to 1

facts.label: Assassin Mastery
facts.value: Grants a random missing skill from: Flash Cut, Ghost Step, Night Rend, Dualwield, Dagger Throw (plus Dagger Rush if you have Ruler's Authority and already know Dagger Throw)

facts.label: Tanker Mastery
facts.value: Grants the first missing Tanker skill in fixed order: Shield Bash, Taunt, Tank Leap, Reinforcement, Willpower, Protection Mark; Tanker class required; consumed only on success

facts.label: Mage Mastery
facts.value: Mage class required ("Only a Mage can use Mage mastery")

facts.label: Already-known skills
facts.value: Preserved - the items never overwrite or duplicate what you have

sections.heading: Mastery item versus runestone
sections.body: A runestone teaches one specific skill to anyone. A Mastery item fills a gap in a class kit: the Tanker item walks the Sentinel order top to bottom, the Assassin item rolls randomly among what you are missing. Mage and Tanker items verify your class before doing anything; if the check fails you keep the item. When a kit is already complete, the Tanker item reports it and is not consumed.

sections.heading: The Ruler's Authority wrinkle
sections.body: The Assassin mastery pool grows: if you hold Ruler's Authority and already know Dagger Throw, Dagger Rush - its Authority-driven evolution - joins the roll. That is currently the only mastery-exclusive interaction verified in code.

nodes.title: Starter Packs
nodes.tagline: Your awakening care package
nodes.summary: When Hunter Evaluation awakens you into a class, the System hands you that class's starter pack. Right-click to unpack a weapon, food, and a piece of armor tuned to the class.

facts.label: Mage pack

facts.label: Fighter pack

facts.label: Tanker pack

facts.label: Healer pack

sections.heading: How you get one
sections.body: The Hunter Evaluation reward service delivers the pack alongside your starting stats and class powers the moment your class is assigned. Packs are single-use items: right-click, the pack disappears, the contents go to your inventory.

sections.heading: The Tanker pack is different
sections.body: It is the only pack with server-side ownership rules: it verifies you are a Tanker, writes a death-persistent redeemed marker so it can never be claimed twice, reconciles your rank entitlements, and drops the rewards on the ground if your inventory is full. Its tooltip also states the E-rank baseline it assumes: Iron Wall plus Shield Bash, with the shield going in your offhand to enable Shield Bash.

sections.heading: Ranger roulette
sections.body: The Ranger pack rolls a 50/50 between the Spirit Bow (bow build, pairs with Mana Quiver) and the Mana Gun (MP-fed sidearm, Ranger-only, 100 + INT mana per shot). You cannot choose; on a server, trade with another Ranger who rolled the other half.
